verdict.rationale: The CDP SDK is documented to programmatically create, manage, and use EVM and Solana wallets, with CDP securing the private keys (gh-1, gh-2). CDP also signs and broadcasts for non-custodial wallets (docs-7). Separately, deposit destinations let developers provision stable onchain addresses for customers or external parties that auto-credit a custodial account, with an optional liquidation mode (docs-1, docs-22, docs-50). missing for 10: detailed key-custody documentation (only summary statements in the pack), explicit per-customer wallet provisioning patterns, independent or hands-on corroboration.
